# `edges.edges.aliases`

[edges](../../README.md) · [edges](../README.md) · aliases

v0.1.12 (additive): the auditable, first-class NL trigger vocabulary for a BUSINESS RELATION. Contrast aliasBlock (whose keys are value codes and whose target is a closed value code): here a surface resolves to THIS EDGE — the relation is the routing target, addressed by edge_id. The deterministic resolver (mac.canon.relation_alias_resolve) binds token→relation via these surfaces; the LLM never chooses the relation (the aliases live on the artifact, not smeared in a rule's prose). Attaches to a level:business edge (typically type:shared_attribute).
